notes.input_bytes: Checked first, before UTF-8 and before the parser recurses.
notes.depth: Nesting of collections, block and flow together: the root collection is depth 1. A document at the bound passes, one level more is refused.
notes.nodes: Counts values, a shared alias reference once per use, never keys: a mapping is one node, each entry value one more. A document at the bound passes, one more is refused.
notes.scalar_bytes: Bytes of one resolved scalar value.
notes.expanded_bytes: Total scalar bytes of the tree after alias expansion; the strict-config profile has no aliases, so no bound.
notes.aliases: Alias tokens in one document; the strict-config profile refuses aliases outright.
